instruction: Candid full shot of an indoor martial arts gym with grey mats. On the left, the man in the grey t-shirt and black shorts (R2) leans forward, clinching with the man in the white t-shirt and blue shorts (R1) on the right. R2 wraps his gloved arms around R1's neck, while R1 defends the hold. In the background, two bystanders watch, one holding a camera. The scene is lit by even overhead lights, casting soft shadows on the grey floor.
